name: Undo Redo Clock
description: Compact pill with undo and redo buttons and a sliding clock face in the middle. Pressing a side slides the clock over it, spins the hands and steps through an action history.
contents: Pill with undo and redo arrow buttons
Sliding round clock face with 12 ticks and two hands
behavior: Press slides the clock toward the pressed side and spins the clock hands
Click steps the action index down or up and calls onUndo or onRedo
Buttons disable at the start and end of the history
Touch press triggers the same animation
fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
